items.name: Spiked Chain
items.description: This 4-foot-long length of chain is covered with barbs and has spikes on one or both ends. Some feature metal hoops used as handgrips.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Half Plate] armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pall of Shadow
offensiveAbilities.description: When a shadow giant hits with a melee attack, the target must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Drained 1 and take a –1 status penalty to Perception checks involving sight as long as they remain drained. On a critical failure, this condition doesn't heal naturally and can be removed only with magic.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadow Chain
offensiveAbilities.description: Shadows extend the giant's chain as they make a spiked chain Strike, increasing their reach to 60 feet for that Strike. If this hits, the target must succeed at a DC 33 Will Saving Throw save or be teleported to an empty space within the shadow giant's normal reach.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadowcloak
offensiveAbilities.description: The shadow giant gains the effect of the Blur spell for 1 minute or until it is exposed to direct sunlight, whichever comes first.
